questions.question: What is the central generalization requirement?
options: The model memorizes every training row
The model performs usefully on representative unseen examples
Training loss reaches exactly zero
The model uses more parameters than examples
questions.explanation: Generalization is useful behavior beyond the examples used to fit the model. Training performance alone cannot establish it.

questions.question: A delivery product must predict minutes from checkout to arrival. Which task family matches that target?
options: Regression
Binary classification
Clustering
Ranking
questions.explanation: Elapsed minutes are a continuous numeric target, so regression matches the output shape.

questions.question: Why is actual delivery time an invalid feature for an ETA produced at checkout?
options: It contains too few categories
It is known only after the prediction is needed
It forces the model to use regression
It cannot be stored in a database
questions.explanation: Using a future outcome leaks target information into training and cannot be reproduced at the checkout prediction moment.

questions.question: Training accuracy is 96% and representative validation accuracy is 74%. What should the team investigate first?
options: Overfitting or leakage
Whether the model has enough capacity to memorize more
Removing the validation set
Deploying immediately because training accuracy is high
questions.explanation: A large train-validation gap means the fitted behavior is not transferring. Overfitting and leakage are direct hypotheses to test.

questions.question: When should explicit rules usually be preferred over ML?
options: The rules are stable and deterministic behavior is required
Representative examples contain a hard-to-express pattern
Prediction errors can be measured against a baseline
Human judgment is expensive at scale
questions.explanation: Stable, maintainable rules avoid the uncertainty and operating cost of a learned model when learning adds little value.

questions.question: Why does an ML rollback restore more than application code?
options: Models cannot have versions
Compatible features, model artifacts, and thresholds jointly determine behavior
Monitoring data must always be deleted
Training examples are compiled into the web server
questions.explanation: Production behavior depends on a compatible set of code, feature transformations, model artifacts, and decision policy.
